🌎 BEYOND THE 956

BARDSTOWN, Ky. — A 31-year-old Bardstown woman was arrested Thursday after a Nelson County grand jury indicted her on charges including first-degree sodomy and incest involving a child under the age of 12, according to court documents.

Lauren Winans faces four charges: two counts of first-degree sodomy, one count of first-degree incest, and one count of first-degree sexual abuse — all alleging offenses against a child younger than 12. The indictment, returned Wednesday, alleges the offenses occurred between Jan. 1, 2022 and Nov. 20, 2022.

Winans is being held on a $250,000 bond. Her arraignment is scheduled for Nov. 5. If convicted on the top charge of first-degree sodomy, she faces up to life in prison, according to reports.

The charges are allegations, and Winans is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: New York Post, Oct. 23, 2026; WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram, Oct. 23, 2026.
